capabilities: : Scan both source and destination folders
disambiguation: Not a backup tool or two-way sync; it is a deliberate, one-way mirror designed only for viewing on mobile devices.
extras: macOS desktop only; operates entirely on local filesystem paths with no telemetry or cloud API usage.
problem: It addresses the difficulty of maintaining a consistent, up-to-date copy of a primary desktop vault on a mobile device without relying on official cloud sync services.
summary: Vault Mirror is a macOS plugin that creates a one-way mirror of the current Obsidian vault to a specified local destination folder, such as iCloud Drive.
